general.title: Commerce approved sales of more than 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, Rep. Mast says
general.summary: Members of Congress have pushed in the wake of the Jensen Huang scandal for legislation to tighten export controls on chip sales to China.

general.title: Japanese Shares Slide as AI Concerns Overshadow Anthropic Debut
general.summary: Japanese equities slumped with tech-related shares hammered as concerns around the artificial intelligence trade linger despite the strong debut of Anthropic’s listing on the stock market.

general.title: Anthropic Slumps 5% Post-Market After Record $107.3 Billion IPO
general.summary: Anthropic PBC shares were down about 5% in post-market trading as the artificial intelligence developer wrapped up its first day as a public company after a record-setting $107.3 billion offering.

general.title: Could a Jensen Huang-Style Scandal Happen at Apple?
general.summary: On the Power On podcast, Joanna Stern joins Mark Gurman to discuss Nvidia’s leadership fallout, Apple’s executive culture under Steve Jobs and Tim Cook and why Cupertino isn’t immune. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Anthropic’s I.P.O. Turns Tech Researchers Into Overnight Millionaires - The New York Times
AMD dives on short seller report of alleged China exposure
general.summary: AMD closed down over 7% after a short seller alleged that its firmware showed up at a blacklisted Chinese company. AMD said it complies with U.S. law.

general.title: UK Consumers Become More Willing to Spend, GfK Survey Finds
general.summary: British consumers regained their appetite for splashing out on things such as furniture and electronics in November, according to a survey that provides some relief for retailers ahead of crucial festive season.

general.title: Anthropic’s Mega IPO Lives Up to Wall Street Hype but Fails to Revive AI Trade - WSJ
Thailand Opens Door to US Pork, Raising Risks for Farmers
general.summary: Thailand crossed a former red line in its trade negotiations with the US, opening its pork market to American competition and adding pressure on a domestic industry already struggling with excess supply and weak prices.

general.title: Currency Playbook Gets Rewritten in Asia as Losers Bounce Back
general.summary: A trade that drove Asian currencies for much of this year is starting to turn, as oil prices retreat and investors slash exposure to the artificial-intelligence trade.

general.title: Gold Set for Worst Week Since March on Hawkish Fed, AI Selloff
general.summary: Gold fell for a fifth day — heading for the biggest weekly decline since March — as a hawkish Federal Reserve signaled more interest-rate hikes and a rout in AI stocks pushed investors to sell the metal to cover losses.

general.title: Gap names new Athleta CEO, lowers full-year guidance
general.summary: Gap on Thursday announced Ashley Kechter as the new CEO of Athleta. The retailer also reported mixed fiscal third-quarter earnings.

general.title: Jacob Coxon speaks out in IPO-day protest at Anthropic: 'It literally doesn't matter whether they invest' - Business Insider
The City at the Center of AI
general.summary: Anthropic’s record-setting IPO is expected to make many of its employees rich, and other AI companies may be next. At the center of this modern gold rush is San Francisco, a city used to booms and busts – but never at this scale. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Fed’s Paulson Says Clear Communication Can Guide Rates
general.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia President Anna Paulson highlighted the importance of clarity in policymakers’ communications on the economy and, at times, their expectations for rates.
